bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Felicita Scale
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the Felicita Scale {name}? Close any phone app connected to the scale, or Home Assistant cannot connect to it.

user.title: Select Felicita Scale
user.description: Select your Felicita Scale from the list of discovered devices.

data_description.address: Scales that are on and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy are listed here. If yours is missing, turn it on, or enter its address manually.

manual.title: Add Felicita Scale manually
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your Felicita Scale.

error.cannot_connect: The scale is not in range. Make sure it is turned on and close to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.invalid_address: Invalid Bluetooth address. Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.not_supported: Device is not a supported Felicita scale

command_failed.message: Failed to send command to the scale: {error}
